currency_note: Token prices are US dollars from the provider pages below. The dashboard converts to GBP only through an editable rate, which is an assumption, not a live FX quote.
output_tokens_default_note: Assumption, not a measured model response. The rules engine's own reasons are about 90 tokens. 400 allows a short JSON verdict with a two-to-four sentence reason. Change it on the dashboard or replace measured blocks below.

models.label: GPT-4o
models.source_note: Standard tier on OpenAI's pricing page, checked 26 Nov 2026. The model page also lists GPT-4o as deprecated; the price list still publishes $2.50 input and $10 output per 1M tokens.
models.speed_note: OpenAI's pricing page does not publish a tokens-per-second figure. 40 is an editable assumption, not a measurement.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.source_note: Claude API standard global list price, checked 26 Nov 2026. Anthropic's rate card dated 9 Nov 2026 shows the same $2 input and $10 output per 1M tokens.
models.speed_note: The pricing page calls the model fast but does not publish tokens per second. 50 is an editable assumption, not a measurement.

models.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.source_note: Paid standard tier, checked 26 Nov 2026. Google lists $0.75 input and $3.75 output per 1M tokens through 31 Dec 2026, then $1.50 and $7.50. Output price includes thinking tokens.
models.speed_note: No tokens-per-second figure is on the pricing page. 80 is an editable assumption, not a measurement.

models.label: Llama 3.3 70B
models.source_note: Groq on-demand price list for Llama 3.3 70B Versatile, checked 26 Nov 2026: $0.59 input and $0.79 output per 1M tokens, listed speed 394 tokens per second. This is hosted inference, not a self-hosted GPU cost. Groq's model docs also show an enterprise SKU as contact-sales; the figure used here is the public on-demand list price.
models.speed_note: 394 tokens/sec is Groq's published on-demand speed for this model, checked 26 Nov 2026. Generation time below uses that figure. It is not a latency measured on these cases.
